summary: Iteration 24 - Marketplace Module testing complete. All 25 backend tests passed. Fixed critical bug in WebSocket notification (send_to_user -> send_personal). Frontend UI verified with full workflow: login, marketplace page, stats, category filters, create listing modal, search functionality.

fixed.issue: WebSocket manager method 'send_to_user' does not exist - should be 'send_personal'
fixed.fix: Changed ws_manager.send_to_user() to ws_manager.send_personal() in lines 649 and 851
fixed.impact: Moderation and interest notification endpoints were returning 500 errors

passed_tests: Auth: Admin login with admin@purelife.rp / Admin@2026!
GET /api/marketplace/categories - Returns 4 categories (vehicles, real_estate, jobs, services)
POST /api/marketplace - Create jobs listing (price: Su richiesta)
POST /api/marketplace/{id}/interest - Cannot express interest on own listing (400)
GET /api/marketplace/stats/summary - Returns stats (total_active, pending_moderation, by_category, my_listings, unread_interests)
frontend_verified: Login page loads and accepts admin credentials
Marketplace page (/marketplace) loads with MERCATO menu item highlighted
Stats cards display: Annunci Attivi, I Miei Annunci, In Attesa, Messaggi Non Letti
Category filters: Tutti, Auto/Moto, Casa, Lavoro, Servizi - all clickable
Search input works and filters listings
Sort dropdown: Più recenti, Meno recenti, Prezzo crescente, Prezzo decrescente, Più visti
'Solo i miei' checkbox filters to show only user's listings
'+ Nuovo Annuncio' button opens create modal
Create modal Step 1: Category selection (Veicoli, Immobili, Lavoro, Servizi)
Create modal Step 2: Form with Titolo, Descrizione, Prezzo, Posizione, Telefono, Email
Listing cards display: title, price, location, views, interests, status badge
Status badges: Attivo (green), In attesa (yellow), Venduto (blue), Rimosso (red)
critical_code_review_comments: WebSocket method naming inconsistency fixed: send_to_user -> send_personal
Marketplace router properly validates input with Pydantic (min_length for title/description)
New listings correctly start in PENDING status requiring staff moderation
Soft delete pattern used (status -> REMOVED) instead of hard delete
Frontend correctly shows different views based on 'my_listings' filter
